notes.title: BOSSGAME Patch Notes v1.1.7
notes.notes:
BOSSGAME has been updated to version 1.1.7!

PATCH NOTES
----------------- 
Fixed an issue where remapped controls would be lost on reboot.



There are still some issues I want to fix with controller support, such as controllers on Mac being a bit unreliable, and adding support for Nintendo Pro Controllers if possible. You may run into issues if your controller is not plugged in on game boot, or if you switch controllers mid-game. If you had remapped controls before this patch, you may have to reset them and remap again.

If your keybinds break for some reason, you can reset them from the rebind screen, or by going to the title screen and pressing the "P" key on your keyboard 12 times.

If you run into issues with remapping your specific controller, and the in-game remapping isn't robust enough, try resetting the in-game rebinds and using Steam Input to rebind. This can be found by right-clicking Bossgame in the library, going to Properties, and then Controller. This can be a workaround for some types of unsupported controllers.

Thank you for understanding! Please have a nice weekend :)

- Lily

notes.title: BOSSGAME Patch Notes v1.1.6
notes.notes:
BOSSGAME has been updated to version 1.1.6! This mostly fixes bugs related to unlocking achievements and in-game lore.

PATCH NOTES
----------------
- Fixed a bug preventing players from earning His Pathetic Evil achievement
- Fixed a bug preventing players from earning Ladykiller achievement, and updated requirements
- Fixed a bug preventing players from earning The Secret is No Secret achievement
- Updated icon for The Secret is No Secret Achievement
- Fixed a bug that prevented Wiki Lore from being unlocked during a Boss Rush
- Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented Wiki Lore from being unlocked during the final boss
- Fixed some incorrectly imported audio files
- Made minor changes to UI and game flow


I am looking into the following issues for a future patch:
- Look into issues with Nintendo Pro Controller when remapping input
- Make Mac controller support more robust


Thank you to everyone who has sent in a bug report, it helps me a lot!

Enjoy your stay in Mammon City,
Lily

notes.title: BOSSGAME: The Final Boss Is My Heart: RELEASE DAY
notes.notes:
BOSSGAME: The Final Boss Is My Heart, is finally available, now on PC and Mac!!

Thank you for waiting! The critically-acclaimed lesbians are now here on the big screen (your computer)!

Bossgame is all about using the power of love & girlfriends to defeat huge, horrifying devils in rhythmic combat. It's about flirting with your girlfriend in the face of corrupt employers, ex-lovers, and the worst creatures you've ever known. 

Please check out the game people are calling "deeply, uncomfortably relatable" and "one of the best queer games of the year" and "smart and endearing in all the right ways" and "how did this 5 hour RPG have me crying"

I've been working on Bossgame over the last four years, and I'm so excited to finally bring it to you. Thank you so much for checking it out, and thank you to everyone who has supported me so far. I really hope you enjoy the game! 


// --- MAJOR NOTES ---

Game is now playable!

// --- KNOWN BUGS ---

[list]
[*] Button remapping for non-XBox, non-Playstation controllers occasionally causes issues.
[*] Button remapping on Mac occasionally causes issues.
        - NOTE: You can hard reset the controls by going to the title screen and tapping the "P" key 12 times.
[*] Steam Deck: Resizing window or changing window mode can occasionally lock game.
[*] Changing aspect ratio occasionally creates minor graphical errors. This is fixed by a game restart.
[/list]
